notes: Redesigned sidebar with compact port throughput, receiver information, and current position sections.
Added dual-device receiver comparison and collapsible secondary-device details.
Clarified receiver-side Input and Output rates and saved byte totals.
Shortened firmware and serial number display with full-value tooltips.
Enabled automatic reconnect globally and removed redundant connection labels.
Raw recording now saves BIN files without JSON sidecars.
Improved command/reply visibility and dual-device terminal clearing.
Made sidebar receiver and position values selectable and copyable.
Added spacing between dual-device sidebar values and the scrollbar.
Added GGA/GNS differential age in seconds for both devices, clearing unavailable or stale values.
Added a leading command-line boundary to terminated manual ASCII commands on both serial and TCP devices; preserved raw and HEX modes.
Command preview now uses the submitted text snapshot rather than reading the input box after transmission.
Satellite signals now prioritize the GGA satellites-used count independently of constellation and signal filters, falling back to signal usage flags when GGA is unavailable.
POSTDATA no longer sends UNLOGALL, preserving existing receiver log outputs.
